lines.en: I found this typewriter next to the courtyard dumpster,
an old Underwood 5 with original carriage return.
Took her home, polished her up,
bought a brand new ribbon off of electronicbay.com.
Okay, somebody's got to do something.
Let's go. I'm gonna throw it away.
No, I'm not. It weighs a billion tons.
If you sons of bitches try to remove this typewriter, I'll kill you.
I'm gonna type every word I know.
